LESSON: CONTEMPORARY ISSUES • RIGHTS OF WOMEN IN ISLAM • HIV AND AIDS • COVID-19 • CHILD ROAD SAFETY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relationship)
Topic 6.3: Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety, part of Muamalat (Social Relationship) in Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How should women be treated in Islam? 2. What are the possible remedies for the spread of HIV and AIDS and COVID-19?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the rights of women in Islam for gender parity,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. describe the modes of transmission of HIV/ and AIDS and COVID-19 to avoid transmission,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. illustrate safe behaviors while using the road for safe road use,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. explain the possible remedies for the spread of HIV/ and AIDS and COVID-19 for healthy living,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. honour the rights of women as a fulfilment of the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.).

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the rights of women in groups and present in class,
2. using digital devices/ books, journals, and newspapers search for information on modes of transmission and remedies for the spread of HIV and AIDS, COVID-19 and present on charts/ PowerPoint,
3. dramatise safe behaviors road users should observe while on the road,
4. discuss the risky behaviors road users indulge in while using the roads (such as playing along the road speeding, distracted driving, use of headphones, ear pods, and other entertainment gadgets that distract pedestrian 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy Skills: the learners they create with digital devices use digital technology effectively to search for

information on modes of transmission and remedies for the spread of HIV and AIDS, COVID-19 and present on charts/

PowerPoint.

• Communication and Collaboration: teamwork is enhanced as learners interact, recognise the value of team members’ ideas

and suggest improvements when discussing the rights of women and risky behaviors road users indulge in while using the

roads.

• Citizenship: social cultural sensitivity and awareness is enhanced through discussions on the rights of women and

brainstorming/search for possible remedies for maintaining road safety for road users.

• Learning to Learn: carrying out research and the skills of creating with digital devices are enhanced as learners use digital

technology effectively to search for information on modes of transmission and remedies for the spread of HIV and AIDS,

COVID-19 and present on charts/ PowerPoint.

Values:
• Social Justice: enhanced through discussion on the rights of women.

• Responsibility: enhanced through researching the modes of transmission and remedies for the spread of HIV and AIDS and

COVID-19.

Main points to remember:

1. identify the rights of women in Islam for gender parity,
2. describe the modes of transmission of HIV/ and AIDS and COVID-19 to avoid transmission,
3. illustrate safe behaviors while using the road for safe road use,
4. explain the possible remedies for the spread of HIV/ and AIDS and COVID-19 for healthy living,
5. honour the rights of women as a fulfilment of the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.).
